title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates acceleration as 5 m/s² using displacement formula with t=6s and x=90m.

title: Speed at 4 seconds
description: Essential: Correctly calculates final speed as 20 m/s using v = at with a=5 m/s² and t=4s.

title: Third-second displacement
description: Essential: Correctly calculates displacement during 3rd second as 12.5 m using difference between positions at t=3s and t=2s.

title: Uniform acceleration reasoning
description: Important: Applies kinematics formulas for uniformly accelerated motion with zero initial velocity.

title: Third-second method
description: Important: Recognizes that displacement during nth second requires subtracting positions at t=n-1 and t=n.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout calculations.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses negative acceleration or incorrect sign in kinematics equations.

title: Third-second misunderstanding
description: Pitfall: Calculates total displacement at t=3s (22.5 m) instead of displacement during 3rd second only.
